capabilities: create buttons with a Button Maker for commands, links, calculations, templates, or text
run multiple actions in sequence with chain or swap buttons
insert inline buttons in notes via button block IDs
remove buttons after clicking and replace note lines with new content
style buttons with colors, CSS classes, and Style Settings
extras: Full documentation is hosted elsewhere ('Read the Documentation for more information'); the README also contains a detailed version-by-version changelog back to 0.0.5.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to place clickable action buttons inside a note, so repetitive actions require going through the command palette or manual editing.

relations.evidence: If the templater arg is true you can include a Templater command inside your button.
Install the Style Settings plugin for an easy way to change the default Button styling.
Open the previous day's daily note using the Periodic Notes Plugin

summary: Plugin that renders clickable buttons in notes to run commands, open links, insert templates or text, do calculations, or chain actions.
